//: This is the manifest file for the SERVER side of the app (the Express backend).
npm reads this file to know the project's name, what commands to run,
and what third-party packages to download.
When we run 'npm install', npm reads this file and downloads everything
listed here into the local 'node_modules/' folder.
better-sqlite3: Library for reading and writing to the SQLite database file.
dotenv: Loads variables from '.env' into process.env.
express: Web framework for the backend API.
multer: Middleware for handling file uploads (multipart/form-data).
node-cron: Schedules functions to run at set times.
name: study-planner-server
description: Backend API for Study Planner (Team 225 | Quintessential)
